verdict_reason: Correct record, but the null-lines rule is split between the record and the service, and the public DTO has no OpenAPI schema.

todos.issue: The rule 'no lines means nothing to check' has two homes: the compact constructor (line 10) keeps a null lines list as null, so SpeciesCheckService.check (line 24) has to test request.lines() == null again. SpeciesCheckResponse's constructor already shows the other choice and always holds a list.
todos.fix: Must: SpeciesCheckRequest.lines() never returns null, and SpeciesCheckService no longer checks it for null. One way: lines = lines == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(lines); then check() reads request == null ? List.of() : request.lines().

todos.issue: SpeciesCheckRequest is the public request body of POST /commodities/species-check and carries no @Schema description or requiredMode, though springdoc is on the classpath (pom.xml) and the OpenAPI guide requires both on every public DTO.
todos.fix: Must: the record and its lines field carry @Schema descriptions, with lines' requiredMode stated. One way: @Schema(description = "Commodity lines whose species to check against MDM") on the record and on lines.
